g.text: Observer in use | Register once; publish only saved progress
to avoid repeating them at startup.
Practice answer submitted through the facade
Grade the answer and prepare a new immutable snapshot.
Set the current progress to nextSnapshot.
Record the result in the active LessonSession.
[A word newly has 3 or more consecutive correct answers]
No observer notification is sent for unsaved progress.
Learning cards follow the same save-then-notify order:
learnCurrentWord() -> recordStudy(word, lastCard) -> advance card -> notifyObservers().
Card confirmation adds no answer attempts or XP and preserves existing mastery.
